/**
 * Step changes trigger notifications. Keep steps independent of display wording.
 */
public enum Step
{
	NOT_IN_GAME,
	IDLE_LOBBY,
	PRE_REPAIR_POUCHES,
	PRE_TAKE_CELLS,
	PRE_TAKE_WEAK_CELL,
	PRE_BUILD_GUARDIAN,
	PRE_BUILD_BARRIER,
	PRE_POSITION,
	REPAIR_TILE,
	MINE_FRAGMENTS_FOR_REPAIR,
	ENTER_PORTAL,
	WAIT_FOR_PORTAL,
	MINE_HUGE_REMAINS,
	FILL_POUCHES,
	LEAVE_HUGE_REMAINS,
	POWER_UP,
	HOLD_STONES,
	CELL_GUARDIAN,
	CELL_BARRIER_BUILD,
	CELL_BARRIER_UPGRADE,
	CELL_BARRIER_RECHARGE,
	DEPOSIT_RUNES,
	GO_TO_ALTAR,
	WAIT_FOR_ALTAR,
	CRAFT_RUNES,
	LEAVE_ALTAR,
	CRAFT_ESSENCE,
	DROP_ESSENCE,
	MINE_FRAGMENTS,
	FREE_SPACE,
	IDLE_DEFEND,
	GAME_OVER
}
